carousel.headline: Boston's rats have a vocabulary. AI is writing the dictionary.
Brick-sized ultrasonic microphones
carousel.body: Boston and the nonprofit Basis recorded about 200 days of audio on trees and fences.

carousel.headline: 1.2 million rat calls
carousel.body: AI filtered out human noise and matched the calls to thermal and video footage.

carousel.headline: Three main calls
carousel.body: A high-pitched alarm, an aggressive squeak, and a friendly 50 kHz call for mates and playmates.

carousel.headline: Chicago should borrow this
carousel.body: We held Orkin's rattiest-city title for ten straight years before Los Angeles took it last fall.
